name: Gem
description: Connect Gem with Claude to bring your recruiting data to where you work. With the Gem MCP, you can query hiring analytics, pull applications, rediscover past talent, and take bulk actions in natural language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gem to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gem to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gem.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gem MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gem lists 32 MCP tools, including add_note_to_person, archive_project, archive_sequence, delete_widget, edit_project_enrollment, edit_sequence_enrollment, edit_sequence_stages, get_application, get_dashboard, get_job, get_metrics_catalog, and get_opening.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gem?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gem in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Gem requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gem is developed by Gem. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
